## Purpose and Repository Shape
This is a curated Google Cloud generative-AI sample repository, not one deployable product. It combines notebooks, reference implementations, sample applications, and infrastructure examples for Gemini, Agent Platform, Search, audio, vision, embeddings, and open/partner models. Root navigation is `README.md`; topic-level entry points include `gemini/README.md`, `search/README.md`, and `setup-env/README.md`.

## Primary Consumption Paths
Most assets are independently runnable notebooks or self-contained samples; there is no shared application runtime or monorepo build entry point. Users typically begin with API/model notebooks under `gemini/getting-started/`, service-specific examples under `agents/`, `search/`, `audio/`, and `vision/`, or deployable sample directories containing their own dependency and container manifests. Representative entry points: `gemini/getting-started/intro_gemini_3_6_flash.ipynb`, `agents/adk/new-hire-onboarding/app/agent.py`, `search/web-app/main.py`.

## Gemini and Agent Workflows
`gemini/` is the largest capability area: model invocation, function calling, MCP, evaluation, RAG, tuning, multimodal live APIs, and end-to-end apps. Agent examples span ADK and Agent Engine, often exposing Python/FastAPI services, state schemas, tools, telemetry, and optional browser UIs. Key examples include `agents/adk/contract-compliance-pipeline/python-extraction-agent/app/fast_api_app.py`, `agents/adk/contract-compliance-pipeline/python-extraction-agent/app/agent.py`, and `gemini/mcp/adk_multiagent_mcp_app/main.py`.

## Application Architecture Examples
Several directories are complete but independent vertical slices, useful as reference architectures rather than shared platform components. Typical boundaries are frontend/UI → HTTP or WebSocket backend → model/agent orchestration → external data/tools. For example, the LangGraph concierge separates graph nodes and FastAPI serving in `gemini/agents/genai-experience-concierge/langgraph-demo/backend/concierge/langgraph_server/fastapi_app.py` and `gemini/agents/genai-experience-concierge/langgraph-demo/backend/concierge/nodes/`; its separate UI is under `gemini/agents/genai-experience-concierge/langgraph-demo/frontend/concierge_ui/`.

## Retrieval, Search, and Data Boundaries
Search and RAG samples demonstrate ingestion/indexing, retrieval, reranking, grounding, evaluation, and answer generation. They interface with managed Google services rather than a repository-wide storage layer. The LlamaIndex RAG sample separates indexing from query serving in `gemini/sample-apps/llamaindex-rag/backend/indexing/run_parse_embed_index.py` and `gemini/sample-apps/llamaindex-rag/backend/app/routers/rag.py`. Agent Search examples provide web and Cloud Function integration in `search/web-app/main.py` and `search/cloud-function/python/vertex_ai_search_client.py`.

## Runtimes and Infrastructure
Material runtimes are Python (notebooks, FastAPI, Flask/Streamlit-style apps), JavaScript/TypeScript (React, Angular, Vite, browser media clients), and Go (some service/job samples). Deployable samples commonly include Dockerfiles; selected systems add Docker Compose, Cloud Build, Terraform, Cloud Run, GKE, App Engine, or Cloud Functions. Infrastructure boundaries are explicit in `gemini/agents/genai-experience-concierge/langgraph-demo/terraform/`, `agents/adk/contract-compliance-pipeline/docker-compose.yml`, and `gemini/multimodal-live-api/project-livewire/server/Dockerfile`.

## External Services and Integration Surfaces
Examples target Google Cloud Generative AI/Gemini and Vertex AI services, including Agent Platform/Agent Engine, Gemini Enterprise/Agent Search, Vector Search, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Document AI, and model-serving infrastructure. Some samples integrate protocol or real-time systems such as MCP, A2A, WebSockets, LiveKit, and browser audio worklets. Concrete integration surfaces include `gemini/multimodal-live-api/livekit-adk/app/livekit_bridge.py`, `search/gemini-enterprise/group-licensing/internal/adapters/`, and `gemini/use-cases/applying-llms-to-data/using-gemini-with-bigquery-remote-functions/`.
